images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Dwelling | Wa

facade.notes: Lucas County Auditor block card (tax-assessment photo, parcel number in frame): a narrow 1.5-storey gable-front house with fish-scale shingles in the gable and a pent roof over a full front porch on classical columns with a solid rail; a concrete two-strip ('ribbon') driveway along the side to a rear garage; sidewalk and grass terrace; a fire hydrant at the curb

why.note: the narrow city lot: the house turns its gable to the street to fit 30-40 ft of frontage
a 1920s retrofit: a driveway squeezed down the side gap to a garage built at the back of the lot
